notes.title: new update: Radiator 2, HD Anniversary Edition!
notes.notes:
I've remastered the Radiator 2 games yet again. Prepare yourself for EVEN MORE GRAPHICS. The game should be a bit more stable too. Full change-log below:

- added birthday cupcake and gift to main menu screen (happy birthday, radiator 2!!!)
- updated engine to Unity 5.6.3p1, should be more stable than before
- updated skin shaders in all chapters, added subsurface scattering to characters
- updated post processing to PostProcessStack v1
- new candles in HMP aftercare
- localized Succulent title screen (unfortunately I can't localize the other title screens though, since they're images... d'oh, sorry)
- fixed some bugs in CondomCorps (this is the secret hidden 4th game that you may or may not have played)
- various small tuning changes and tweaks
